chunks: Hadith 2417 — Abu Basir narrated from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:

“Whoever says when he goes out from the door of his house: ‘I seek refuge in Allah from that from which the angels of Allah sought refuge: from the evil of this day, from the evil of the devils, from the evil of whoever has set himself against the friends of Allah, Mighty and Glorious, from the evil of the jinn and humankind, from the evil of wild beasts and creeping harmful creatures, and from the evil of committing all forbidden acts. I place myself under Allah’s protection from every evil’— Allah will forgive him, accept his repentance, suffice him regarding his concern, restrain him from evil, and protect him from الشر.”
ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited when leaving the house for protection from evil?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a supplication to be recited when leaving one’s home, seeking refuge in Allah from many outward and inward harms. It emphasizes divine protection, forgiveness, repentance, and safeguarding from evil through remembrance of Allah.
